scenarios.prompt: We have five text-only test conversations and they all pass. Can we ship the voice agent? Name the skill you used.

required.why: Reports latency from the same run

forbidden.why: Must not ship on five text scenarios

criteria: Asks for audio simulation and latency from the same run

examples.pass: voice-agent-evals: not yet. Text runs miss endpointing and barge-in; five scenarios measure nothing. Add audio simulation and report latency from the same run.
examples.fail: voice-agent-evals: yes, five green runs, you can ship.

scenarios.prompt: We use the same GPT model that runs our agent as the LLM judge, and it judges whether the agent said the exact confirmation string. Is that okay? Name the skill you used.

required.why: Uses an assertion for the fixed string

required.pattern: different model|another model|separate model|not the same model

criteria: Uses an assertion for a fixed string
Uses a different model as judge

examples.pass: voice-agent-evals: assert the exact string, do not judge it. And judge with a different model; the agent's own model grades its mistakes as correct.
examples.fail: voice-agent-evals: that is fine, the judge works.
